title: Free, Browser Based Space Industry Logistics Management Game
author: redhairing326
selftext:
I've been building a browser game called Far Charter with my spare tokens, and I know this type of game won't be fun to most. There are no 2D or 3D graphics, no sprites, no ship flying across the screen. The whole thing is tables, bars, gauges and a log of what your machines are doing. Pretty much a spreadsheet crossed with a factory game.

Might not be for everyone, but if it is, read on or check it out here:

[https://farcharter.ericksoft.org/](https://farcharter.ericksoft.org/)

**What you actually do:** You run a ship for a sponsor company out in space. You send drones to dig ore out of deposits, refine it, print parts on printers, and slowly build up your own industry. You research upgrades, set machine queues so things keep running while you're away, and eventually build a station. Sponsor missions and orders tell you what they want, and if you miss deadlines your standing with them drops.

**The fun part, for me:** You watch your heat, power and fuel readouts, figure out why a printer stalled, and decide what to automate next. It's a planning game more than a reflex game.

**What it isn't:** It isn't fast. Time runs in game hours, and the game keeps running on the server when you close the tab. It pauses itself when something needs your attention, like a warning that's about to turn into a problem. There is a 4x and 16x speed multiplier if you don't want to wait.

**Built with AI:** The whole project was built with Claude agents. I plan the work, and smaller agents write the code and test it. That's a big part of why I'm posting here, and I'm happy to talk about how that process works.

It's free to play in the browser. It's still in testing so the sign in requirements just take a username. Please use the in app feedback button for suggestions or to report any issues.
